item.record_dawn_1.name: Record: Daybreak over the Bay
item.record_dawn_1.desc: Lyudmilovsk Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra, on the Priboi label. The amber sleeve shows the sea and one gull who woke before everyone else.
music.rec.dawn_1.note: The strings rise slowly, like the sun out of the water. Far off a little bell rings, like a buoy.
item.record_dawn_2.name: Record: Morning Étude
item.record_dawn_2.desc: Vera Solntseva, piano, on the Priboi label. The sleeve is pale blue, with a piano standing right on the sand.
music.rec.dawn_2.note: Solntseva plays so softly you can hear the stool creak. I think she has just woken up too.
item.record_day_1.name: Record: Breeze on the Promenade
item.record_day_1.desc: The Dune Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The yellow sleeve shows beach umbrellas on the third terrace, seen from above.
music.rec.day_1.note: Guitar and glockenspiel, light as noon on the promenade. It makes me want to buy an ice cream, though I already have one.
item.record_day_2.name: Record: Quiet October
item.record_day_2.desc: Vera Solntseva and string quartet, on the Priboi label. The sleeve is grey like the sky over town, with one wet maple leaf on it.
music.rec.day_2.note: The piano talks and the violins agree. Music about a day when nothing happened, and that's fine.
item.record_day_3.name: Record: Sky over the Dunes
item.record_day_3.desc: The Dune Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The sky-blue sleeve has dunes, pines and a great deal of sky.
music.rec.day_3.note: The synth rolls in like waves, and kalimba notes drip on top. Good for lying on the floor and looking at the ceiling.
item.record_dusk_1.name: Record: Golden Hour
item.record_dusk_1.desc: The Lebedev Duo, on the Priboi label. On the orange sleeve a cello casts a long evening shadow.
music.rec.dusk_1.note: The cello holds one low note and the piano walks round it like round a lamppost. I felt sad, but warm.
item.record_dusk_2.name: Record: The Last Light
item.record_dusk_2.desc: The Albatross Instrumental Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The plum-coloured sleeve shows the last windows of the Korona sanatorium going dark one by one.
music.rec.dusk_2.note: The synth carries the tune like a shy clarinet. While it plays, it seems still light outside, though it isn't.
item.record_night_1.name: Record: Stars over the Pier
item.record_night_1.desc: Lyudmilovsk Philharmonic Chamber Orchestra, on the Priboi label. A dark-blue sleeve with stars and the lamp at the end of the pier.
music.rec.night_1.note: The celesta rings now and then, with a long echo between notes, like the space between stars. I switched off the light so as not to interfere.
item.record_night_2.name: Record: Moon Music Box
item.record_night_2.desc: The Weathervane Early Music Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The violet sleeve has a moon with a tiny music box and key inside it.
music.rec.night_2.note: Scraps of a music box drift in from far away, as if someone next door can't sleep. The town sleeps; the music doesn't.
item.record_rain_1.name: Record: A Piece for Rain
item.record_rain_1.desc: Arkady Tikhomirov, piano, on the Priboi label. The grey-blue sleeve shows a rain-spotted window and a cup on the sill.
music.rec.rain_1.note: Tikhomirov plays a chord and waits a long time before the next. I'm in no hurry either.
item.record_rain_2.name: Record: Drops on the Glass
item.record_rain_2.desc: The Albatross Instrumental Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The grey-green sleeve shows a wet cable car cabin and somebody's umbrella.
music.rec.rain_2.note: The electric piano wobbles a little, as if the tape got wet. Very cosy, if you don't think about rain tomorrow too.
item.record_storm_1.name: Record: Storm from the Sea
item.record_storm_1.desc: Lyudmilovsk Radio Symphony Orchestra, on the Priboi label. The sleeve is almost black, with the lighthouse and a wave taller than it.
music.rec.storm_1.note: The low strings gather like clouds over the sea, and timpani grumble somewhere past the horizon. I shut the window, just in case.
item.record_snow_1.name: Record: First Snow
item.record_snow_1.desc: The Weathervane Early Music Ensemble, on the Priboi label. A white sleeve with nothing on it but a cat's paw prints.
music.rec.snow_1.note: The music box and glass chime so finely it seems snow is falling right in the room. I suddenly wanted tea.
item.record_sea_1.name: Record: The Sea Breathing
item.record_sea_1.desc: Horizon Studio, on the Priboi label. The deep-blue sleeve has only the sea and a thin horizon line.
music.rec.sea_1.note: The music breathes in and out like the Baltic at the sixth terrace. I caught myself breathing in time with it.
item.record_club_1.name: Record: Night Shift
item.record_club_1.desc: Academgorodok Electronic Studio, on the Priboi label. A dark purple sleeve with a punched tape curled into a wave.
music.rec.club_1.note: Warm chords and tape hiss, as if someone in Academgorodok didn't go home after work. It sounds like our Aton club at midnight.
item.record_club_2.name: Record: Dream of a Computer
item.record_club_2.desc: Sound Lab, Academgorodok Computing Centre, on the Priboi label. The turquoise sleeve shows a computer with a little dream cloud above it.
music.rec.club_2.note: Far away a square-wave arpeggio beeps, like a machine counting sheep in its sleep. Maru would approve.
item.record_club_3.name: Record: Screen Glow
item.record_club_3.desc: Academgorodok Electronic Studio, on the Priboi label. A dark grey sleeve with a green cursor blinking in the corner.
music.rec.club_3.note: Glassy bells over a warm hum, like monitors somebody forgot to switch off. I turned it down, though there's no one to wake but Maru.
item.record_flight_1.name: Record: Over the Pines
item.record_flight_1.desc: The Swift Ensemble, on the Priboi label. The sleeve shows a bird's-eye view of pines, the beach and our cable car.
music.rec.flight_1.note: The arpeggios take off and circle like gulls over the market. With this record on I first thought the floor might not be the bottom.
music.player.play: I put on one of my records: "{0}", {1}.
music.player.more: E again: my next record ({0} of {1}).
music.player.none: I don't have any records of my own yet: they sell them at the Volna shop and the department store. On the player now: "{0}", {1}.
music.player.stop: I took the record off and slid it back into its sleeve.
music.radio.name: Lyudmilovsk Wave
music.radio.off: I switched off the radio. The announcer finished his sentence without me.
music.radio.now.weather: the weather forecast and the tides.
music.radio.now.shipping: the shipping forecast, slowly and in order.
music.radio.now.sign_on: the call sign: we're on the air.
music.radio.now.sign_off: the station is saying good night.
music.radio.now.off_air: Nothing on the air till six in the morning, just a rustle.
music.radio.cap.sign_on.1: This is Lyudmilovsk Wave. We are beginning our broadcast.
music.radio.cap.sign_on.2: Good morning, comrades! Good morning, gulls!
music.radio.cap.sign_on.3: It is six in the morning in Lyudmilovsk. The lighthouse goes dark, the cable car wakes up.
music.radio.cap.sign_off.1: That brings Lyudmilovsk Wave's broadcast to a close. Good night.
music.radio.cap.sign_off.2: We'll meet again at six. Don't forget to switch off your radio.
music.radio.news.intro: The latest news. Here is what's new in Lyudmilovsk.
music.radio.news.outro: That was the news. Stay tuned to the Wave.
music.radio.fest.sign_on: Happy holiday, town! Today is {0}, and the air is festive right up to the night.
music.radio.fest.news: Everyone knows the day's main news: today is {0}. The holiday's programme is on the posters and in the paper.
music.radio.fest.hour: This is the holiday programme: today is {0}. Music for those already out in the street, and for those still looking for the other shoe.
music.radio.news.1: The cable car closes for maintenance from one to three. Cabins are washed, cables greased, conductors drink tea.
music.radio.news.2: The House of Culture veterans' choir is learning a new programme and invites basses. Especially basses.
music.radio.news.3: The town library has opened a new reading room with a sea view. Readers are asked not to look out of the window longer than at their books.
music.radio.news.4: The lamp at the end of the pier is lit again. Fishermen say being without it was like being without a toothbrush.
music.radio.news.5: The goat missing from the allotments by the market has been found on the second beach terrace. She was sunbathing and didn't want to leave.
music.radio.news.6: The Korona sanatorium's mineral spring is open to everyone again. Bring your own glass; the sanatorium's mugs stay where they are.
music.radio.news.7: Starlings have taken over the department store roof. Shoppers are asked not to stand under the eaves bareheaded.
music.radio.news.8: The pair of swans by the old landing have hatched cygnets. Crumble their bread small rather than throwing a whole loaf.
music.radio.news.9: The Zarya fishing cooperative is back with a good catch. Baltic herring will be at the market in the morning: big and cheerful, they say.
music.radio.news.10: The House of Culture chess club held a simultaneous display. The grandmaster lost one game to a Young Pioneer and shook his hand for a long time.
music.radio.news.11: The Rassvet cinema announces an adventure film week. Tickets for the last show are almost gone, and for the first one too.
music.radio.news.12: The bakery has launched a new caraway loaf, the Primorsky. In the queue on Novikova Street they already call it "the one".
music.radio.news.13: An eighth-form pupil from School No. 2 has taken first place at the astronomy olympiad. She found that more stars can be seen from the school roof than the teacher said.
music.radio.news.14: The Academgorodok telescope will show the Moon to anyone on a clear night. Staff ask visitors not to tap the tube: it won't bring the Moon any closer.
music.radio.news.15: The Yantar restaurant has a new menu. The fish soup stays the same because it can't get any better.
music.radio.news.16: The lighthouse keeper reports: the lamp is fine, the gulls are fine, and so is he, thank you.
music.radio.news.17: A new honey stall from Academgorodok has opened at the market. The bees there, they say, also have degrees.
music.radio.news.18: New Priboi records are on sale at the department store. The record department asks customers not to listen to the whole stock in the booth.
music.radio.news.19: The Aton computer club on the cliff invites schoolchildren to classes. The club cat promises not to sit on the keyboard, mostly.
music.radio.news.20: The town brass band will play on the promenade by the fountain. The rehearsal could be heard at the market, so many will come prepared.
music.radio.news.21: The post office reminds you to write the postcode on envelopes. A letter addressed "to Grandma in the village" got there, but only just.
music.radio.news.22: The beach rescue station held a drill. They saved Petya the dummy; he is doing well.
music.radio.news.23: The children's music school is looking for the owner of a grand piano that has stood in its corridor for a year. It's a good piano, but it's in the way.
music.radio.news.24: The lost property office at the cable car station holds forty umbrellas, three hats and one fishing rod. The rod's owner is especially awaited.
music.radio.news.25: The library has extended its hours to nine in the evening. The watchman agreed; the library cat is still thinking it over.
music.radio.news.26: Fishermen on the pier report that the fish are biting. They report nothing else, being busy.
music.radio.news.27: The Korona sanatorium invites townsfolk to a dance evening in the winter garden. Guests promise not to step on toes.
music.radio.news.28: The benches on the third beach terrace have been painted. The Wet Paint sign has already gone; the paint hasn't dried.
music.radio.news.29: Academgorodok has tested a new computer. It solved the problem in a second, then was silent all day.
music.radio.news.30: The amber hunters' club found a walnut-sized piece of amber on the beach. Inside, they say, is a mosquito, very old and very surprised.
music.radio.news.31: The fire station held an open day. The children climbed the ladder, and one dad still can't get down from it.
music.radio.news.32: The House of Culture drama studio is staging a play about a lighthouse. The part of the lighthouse is still open: tall and patient wanted.
music.radio.news.33: Bus number three is back on its old route through the market. The driver says it's more fun that way.
music.radio.news.34: The young naturalists' station has ringed two hundred starlings. The starlings took it in good part.
music.radio.news.35: The clock on the Wave Tower is keeping good time again. Anyone who was late is now late by the correct time.
music.radio.news.36: The town gardens have planted new roses by the cinema. Couples are asked to pick them with their eyes only.
music.radio.news.winter.1: The rink at the stadium is flooded and frozen. Skate hire is open till eight; bring your own mittens.
music.radio.news.winter.2: The cable car is running despite the snow. The cabins go slower, but the view is better.
music.radio.news.winter.3: The swans are wintering by the sanatorium's warm outflow. Please don't feed them cabbage pies.
music.radio.news.spring.1: The starlings are back. The nest boxes by the school are taken; free places only on the department store roof.
music.radio.news.spring.2: The winter boards are being taken off the beach. The first holidaymakers are already sitting on the sixth terrace in their coats.
music.radio.news.spring.3: A hundred people turned out for the clean-up day at the lighthouse. The lighthouse is whiter; the gulls are offended.
music.radio.news.summer.1: The water by the shore has warmed to eighteen degrees. The lifeguards say that's almost hot.
music.radio.news.summer.2: The open-air cinema on the promenade has opened its season. Mosquitoes are asked to come to the last show only.
music.radio.news.summer.3: The kvass queue at the market today was longer than the cinema queue. A second barrel is promised.
music.radio.news.autumn.1: The Korona sanatorium has closed its summer season and opened its autumn one. The difference, they say, is only the blankets.
music.radio.news.autumn.2: Schoolchildren collected two tonnes of waste paper. In it they found a textbook the whole class had been looking for.
music.radio.news.autumn.3: The wind stripped the town gardens of leaves in a single night. The street sweepers are holding on but ask the wind not to do it again.
music.radio.weather.intro: The weather forecast for Lyudmilovsk and the coast.
music.radio.tide.rising: The tide is coming in; high water around {0}.
music.radio.tide.falling: The tide is going out; low water around {0}.
music.radio.weather.advice.rain: Don't forget your umbrella, and don't forget it in the cable car either.
music.radio.weather.advice.snow: Sand your steps and walk the terraces carefully, like penguins.
music.radio.weather.advice.fog: The lighthouse has its foghorn on. Fishermen are advised to stay close to the pier.
music.radio.weather.advice.cold: Put a hat on. Yes, you too.
music.radio.weather.advice.warm: A good day for the beach. Don't forget a sun hat and water.
music.radio.weather.advice.clear: The stars will be clear tonight. Academgorodok is already polishing its telescope.
music.radio.weather.advice.wind: Hold on to your hats, and don't hang washing out on the upper terraces today.
music.radio.weather.advice.storm: Stay away from the water and the pier. The cable car may stop: better to wait it out at home.
music.radio.ship.intro: Here is the shipping forecast for the Baltic Sea.
music.radio.ship.outro: That was the shipping forecast. A quiet watch to all at sea.
music.radio.req.intro: We begin our Request Concert. Your postcards are already on our desk.
music.radio.req.outro: That's all the requests for today. Write to us: the Wave's box is waiting for your postcards.
music.radio.req.1: Nina Petrovna of Novikova Street asks for "{0}" for her grandson, who is serving in the navy.
music.radio.req.2: The lighthouse keeper asks for "{0}" for the gulls who listen to his radio with him.
music.radio.req.3: Cable car conductor Zoya asks for "{0}" for everyone who rode without a ticket today. She saw you.
music.radio.req.4: Class 5B of School No. 2 asks for "{0}" for their maths teacher, whose birthday it is. They also ask to postpone the test.
music.radio.req.5: Mr and Mrs Kornilov at the Korona sanatorium ask for "{0}" for forty years together. They met right here, on the third terrace.
music.radio.req.6: The Zarya fishing crew ask for "{0}" for their wives waiting on shore. And for the cook waiting for the fish.
music.radio.req.7: Librarian Olga Sergeevna asks for "{0}" for the reader who returned a book after eleven years. No hard feelings.
music.radio.req.8: Pensioner Ignatyev from the pier asks for "{0}" for the fish that got away yesterday. Let it know he bears no grudge.
music.radio.req.9: Sveta, aged seven, asks for "{0}" for her dog Palma. Palma loves the radio and hates the vacuum cleaner.
music.radio.req.10: Lab assistants at Academgorodok ask for "{0}" for the computer that has been running three days straight.
music.radio.req.11: The cooks at the Yantar ask for "{0}" for the diner who ate three bowls of fish soup and asked for the recipe. We won't give it.
music.radio.req.12: Clinic nurse Tamara asks for "{0}" for everyone who didn't cry at their jab today. Especially one grown-up.
music.radio.req.13: An anonymous listener on Port Street asks for "{0}" for the girl in the blue beret in the bakery queue. He was standing behind her.
music.radio.req.14: Veteran Stepan Ilyich asks for "{0}" for his old friend in Riga. Let him switch on his set if the wind is blowing our way.
music.radio.req.15: The department store's record counter assistant asks for "{0}". She says it's the only record she hasn't tired of playing for customers.
music.radio.req.16: A holidaymaker from Leningrad asks for "{0}" for Lyudmilovsk itself. She leaves tomorrow and wants the town to remember her.
music.radio.req.hero: And this postcard went into the Wave's box yesterday: a young listener from the cliff asks for "{0}" {1}.
music.radio.req.to.4: for the girl in the cable car cabin
music.radio.req.to.5: just for everyone who's still awake
music.radio.req.to.6: for the lighthouse keeper, so he isn't bored
music.radio.req.to.7: for the gulls over the cliff, no hard feelings
music.radio.req.to.8: for everyone who stays at the Aton club till night
music.req.posted: I dropped a postcard in the Wave's request box: "Please play '{0}' {1}." They'll read it tomorrow at eight in the evening.
music.req.need_card: Radio requests go in on postcards. They sell postcards at the newspaper kiosk.
music.req.already: My postcard is already in the box. They'll read it on the Request Concert.
music.req.heard: They read out my request on the radio!
music.radio.sail.intro: For everyone going out under sail: the Luch sailing school's report.
music.radio.sail.dir.2: an easterly off the land, gusty
music.radio.sail.dir.6: a westerly off the sea, steady
music.radio.sail.force.0: Nearly a calm, the water like glass.
music.radio.sail.force.1: Ripples and a light breeze: just right for the Optimists.
music.radio.sail.force.2: A steady wind, a few white horses here and there.
music.radio.sail.force.3: White horses on the water: you'll be hiking out.
music.radio.sail.force.4: White crests all over the roads: Luches, take in a reef.
music.radio.sail.call.sail: The mast by the boathouse says go. The best time is around {0}.
music.radio.sail.call.sail_any: The mast by the boathouse says go, all classes.
music.radio.sail.call.reef: Sailing is on, but the Luches go reefed and the youngest may have to stay ashore.
music.radio.sail.call.race: Racing today: {0}. The warning signal is at {1}.
music.radio.sail.call.storm: Storm warning: the cone is up the mast, nobody goes out.
music.radio.sail.why.gust: the gusts are worse than they look
music.radio.sail.why.fog: fog, you can't see the shore
music.radio.sail.why.low_water: the water's gone out too far for the trolleys
music.radio.sail.shift.1: By midday the wind will veer: keep to the right of the course.
music.radio.sail.shift.2: By midday the wind will back: the left side pays.
music.radio.sail.shift.3: The wind will die away towards evening: don't go far from the shore.
music.radio.sail.shift.4: The wind will pick up after lunch: the youngest had better come in early.
music.radio.sail.recall_risk: The coaches warn: if the wind gets up, the recall flag goes up at once.
music.radio.sail.low_water: Low water at {0}: a long haul over the flats with the trolleys, so come half an hour early.
music.radio.sail.special.sail_opening: The sailing season opens today! The flag goes up by the boathouse at ten, the parade of sail passes the pier at eleven.
music.radio.sail.special.sail_closing: The sailing season closes today: the last race at eleven, and at sunset the flag comes down till spring.
music.radio.sail.special.cup_lyudmilovsk: The Lyudmilovsk Cup is on in the roads today. Racing off the pier from eleven to four.
music.radio.sail.special.optimist_day: Happy Children's Day! At eleven, the children's Optimist regatta off the pier.
music.radio.sail.race_today: Off the pier today: {0}, starting at {1}. Supporters welcome on the pier.
music.radio.sail.abandoned: {0}, {1} class: the race was abandoned; the weather decided for the officials.
